options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: change_load_balance_link_count
options.description: Indicates whether to increment the load balance link count when C(add) a new link to the NRG or decrement the load balance link count when C(remove) a link from the NRG.

options.name: line_description
options.description: A string that contains the local system line description associated with this link. This parameter is required when source-address is an IPv6 link-local address and is used to identify a unique local interface. It is ignored for all other addresses.

options.name: link_priority
options.description: A string that contains an integer value set as the priority of the link. The range of priorities is from 1 to 16, where 1 is the highest priority. Priority values do not need to be unique. Required when the operation is C(add) Ignored when the operation is C(remove)

options.name: nrg_name
options.description: A string that contains the name of the NRG where the link is to be added. If the NRG does not exist, it will be created.

options.name: source_address
options.description: A string that contains the local IP address for the link to add. Either an IPv4 or an IPv6 address can be specified. When the operation is C(remove), it can also contain the following special value C(*ALL) to remove all links for this NRG.

options.name: target_address
options.description: A string that contains the remote IP address for the link to add. Either an IPv4 or an IPv6 address can be specified. Required when the operation is C(add) Ignored when the operation is C(remove)

options.name: virtual_lan_id
options.description: A string that contains an integer value for the local virtual LAN identifier associated with this link. This parameter is required when source-address is an IPv6 link-local address and is used to identify a unique local interface. It is ignored for all other addresses.
